extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) three rows with negative Quantity values (violating the rule that Quantity must be ≥1), which were excluded; (2) one row with an invalid date ('not-a-date'), which was set to missing; (3) three rows where Revenue did not match Quantity × Price, which were corrected. The Price column had one value with a dollar sign ('$6.00'), which was successfully converted to a number. After these fixes, the analysis shows that 69 units were sold in the North, 64 in the West, 53 in the East, and 34 in the South.
